Thanks Maria — got the attachments and appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple clarifying questions from procurement and security:

1) Endorsement scope: Our legal/risk team prefers an additional insured endorsement tied to contractual liability for the services you will perform (DataPulse as a data processor). The limited additional-insured language can be acceptable in some cases if it expressly covers claims arising from your performance under the Redwood SOW. Can you paste the exact endorsement text from the broker or provide the insurer contact for verification?

2) Cyber limits: What is the current cyber limit and retroactive date on the policy? We need at least a 1M per-claim / 2M aggregate baseline for data processors handling customer PII — if you have higher limits, please specify.

3) Subcontractor flow-down: For the two named subs, we need confirmation that flow-down insurance is included (or that DataPulse assumes responsibility). The subcontractor spreadsheet looks fine but we need a short statement from your broker or from your side confirming flow-down.

Operational ask: Procurement can provisionally open a PO in our system but we typically hold final release until the DPA is countersigned and insurance endorsement is confirmed. If you can provide the broker contact + endorsement wording within 7 business days, we can move to a conditional PO status that allows onboarding scheduling but with billing held until documents are fully accepted.

CC’ing Irene from Risk who will confirm language acceptance and Marissa on the finance side to flag PO timing.

Best,
Jonas Weber
